senses.gloss:
mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Near, proximate.
2 Married.
3 Arrayed, arranged.
E.
उप before, वह to bear, affix क्त.

f. (-ती)
A potherb, (Basella rubra or lucida.)
E.
उप much, उद water, deriv. irr.

f. (-का)
A potherb, (Basella rubra or lucida.)
E.
उप and उद water, कन् and टाप् affixes, and इ substituted for the pen. or ई being substituted उपोदीका.

m. (-तः)
1 A beginning, a thing begun.
2 An introduction, a preface.
3 An example, an apposite argument or illustration.
4 Analysis, the ascertainment of the elements of which a thing consists.
E.
उप before हन to injure, affix घञ्.

n. (-णं)
A fast, fasting.
E.
उप, वस to abide, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Fasted, fasting.
(-तं)
Fast, fasting.
E.
उप before वस to abide, क्त aff.
